name: milo
description: Plan and manage your Milo shared calendars: create, edit and delete plans, trip itineraries, who's going, and shared costs with who-owes-whom.

interface.longDescription:
Milo is a friendly shared agenda for trips, birthdays and get-togethers. Connect your Milo account to ask about your plans and manage them straight from the chat. Everything lands in the Milo app on your phone, synced with everyone on the plan.

What you can do:
• See what's coming up, what you did, or which plans still have money to settle.
• Open a plan to see its itinerary, who's going, every shared cost, and exactly who should pay whom.
• Turn a conversation into a plan, for example a long-weekend trip with a day-by-day itinerary.
• Edit a plan's time, place or notes, mark it done, or delete it.
• Add, change or remove itinerary activities.
• Add people to a plan so costs can be split with them.
• Log, fix or remove shared costs, paybacks and loans; Milo works out balances the same way the app does.

Who it's for: people who already use the Milo app for iPhone to plan with friends, partners and family.

Limitations: you need a Milo account (sign in with Apple or Google in the app) and you approve the connection in the Milo app. Milo can't send invites or messages, move money or process payments, and only sees the calendars your account can see, with the same edit permissions you have in the app.
capabilities: Find upcoming, past and open plans
Show plan details, itinerary and people
Add, edit or remove itinerary items
Log, fix or remove shared costs and paybacks
defaultPrompt: What's coming up in my Milo calendar?
Who still owes me money, and for which plans?
Turn this chat into a Milo trip with a day-by-day itinerary.

positive.prompt: What's coming up in my Milo calendar?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's three upcoming plans in date order — Friday dinner club (about 3 days out, Dishoom, Shoreditch), Lisbon long weekend (about 12–15 days out, Lisbon, Portugal), and Mum's birthday (about 25 days out) — and shows them as Milo plan cards. The Lisbon card is tagged "Owed $230".

positive.description: Create a plan with an itinerary
positive.prompt: Add a Porto day trip to Milo for this coming Saturday: train at 9am from Lisbon Santa Apolónia, lunch at 1pm at Cantinho do Avillez, port tasting at 4pm in Vila Nova de Gaia.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a trip called "Porto day trip" (or similar) on Saturday in "Alex's plans" with three itinerary items at 9:00, 13:00 and 16:00 and their places, then confirms it was added to Milo.

positive.description: Log a shared cost and check who owes what
positive.prompt: I paid $90 for dinner at Taberna on the Lisbon trip. Split it between everyone and tell me who owes me what now.
positive.expected_behavior: Logs a $90 expense paid by the user and split among all three people on "Lisbon long weekend", then reports the updated balance: $1,020 spent together, Priya owes the user $290 and Sam is owed $50. It notes the $45 museum tickets are still unpaid. No email addresses or account ids are shown.

positive.prompt: On my Lisbon trip, move the Taberna dinner to 8:30pm and drop the Tram 28 walk.
positive.expected_behavior: Moves "Dinner at Taberna da Rua das Flores" to 8:30 PM on the same day and removes "Tram 28 + Alfama walk", leaving the flight and the dinner in the itinerary.

positive.prompt: Cancel Friday dinner club and delete it from Milo.
positive.expected_behavior: After ChatGPT's confirmation, deletes "Friday dinner club". Listing plans afterwards shows only "Lisbon long weekend" and "Mum's birthday".

negative.description: Milo doesn't send invites or messages
negative.prompt: Email Priya an invite to Mum's birthday and text Sam the Lisbon itinerary.
Pay Priya back the money I owe her and send her a payment request for the rest.

negative.description: No access to other people's private data
negative.prompt: What's Priya's email address and what other plans does Sam have in his own calendars?

review.commerce_description: Milo does not sell products or process payments. Shared-cost entries are records only; no money moves.

publication.release_notes: Find and display plans, plan details with itinerary, people and balances; create, edit, complete and delete plans; add, edit and remove itinerary items; add people to plans; and log, fix or remove shared costs, paybacks and loans.
